source_candidates.claim: When a saved sessions_send source or target endpoint is reset, replaced or archived, recovery first persists a blocked-delivery conversation notice and only then calls the existing pending-input withdrawal with current authority. Successful withdrawal cancels automatic replay while retaining accepted input. Refused notice storage leaves recovery eligible; permission/transient failures remain retryable. Crash between notice and withdrawal may repeat cleanup. Orphan repair now requires already-loaded ancestry and the exact rewind parent, preserving omitted user-visible notices without loading/replaying them.
author_reports_not_independently_reprodu: The real-SQLite regression and two-restart Gateway assertions are present in the reviewed patches; they were not executed here.
Author reports final prepared-head cold-restart success and focused suites. Run metadata independently confirms success, without inspection of individual jobs or logs.
An older bot review requires changes on head5482090…, and another mutable summary refers to1d461b5…; neither is the final d28abe4… head.
source_candidates.our_inference: Durable recovery is a protocol between notice visibility, replay eligibility and generation fences; preserving accepted bytes alone does not establish usable completion. This is our public-source hypothesis, not a claim about a person's private research plans.
source_candidates.next_falsifiable_gate: In an independently implemented packaged two-process test, crash before notice, after notice/before withdrawal, and after withdrawal. Require durable retained input, one visible notice, no cross-generation delivery, no automatic second-boot retry only after successful notice, and positive transient-permission/storage retries; include loaded/omitted ancestry and exact-parent controls.

source_candidates.claim: Native worker-turn environment stop now starts alongside local settlement before workspace draining, removing the circular wait where a foreground command owns the queue needed for its own cancellation. Supported workspace drain is attempted even when environment stop rejects. Remote stop/drain acknowledgements share at most10s of the remaining process cleanup budget; expiry retains an unconfirmed owner for reconnect cleanup and is not proof of physical termination. Remote-exec attached applications retain their independent lifetime. Local accepted operations and transfer cleanup still join before retirement; named cleanup spans add attribution.
author_reports_not_independently_reprodu: Author reports Linux real-workspace/tunnel synthetic fixture proof including child/grandchild extinction; this is an owner-boundary fixture, not full shipped Gateway/durable database proof or production latency.

source_candidates.claim: Only CLI respawn producers inject a private preload that records launcher PID and consumes itself from execArgv so detached update drivers do not inherit the lifetime contract. Bound CLI IPC disconnection requests ordinary SIGTERM cancellation; maintenance heartbeat can detect recorded-parent loss/start-identity change, asks the main thread to cancel, continues renewing ownership while rollback/lease release/service restoration settle, and supplies a10s forced-termination backstop. Dead launcher alone does not authorize peer takeover of a live writer.
author_reports_not_independently_reprodu: Reviewed new source tests use real subprocess/SQLite owner fixtures to distinguish independent detached commit from bound rollback and successor acquisition. No upstream tests executed here.
Author reports packaged macOS SIGKILL-launcher recovery, zero descendants and same-state GatewayHTTP200/SQLitequick_check; raw proof artifacts were not inspected.

Final prepared-head CI38923213198 is failure, independently observed through exact-head workflow list. PR body does not identify its final root cause; old bot findings on7528c0c… cannot be assumed current or resolved merely from that CI status. The final merge patch restricts parent metadata to the producer preload, but the added census mock lacks the annotation later supplied by174359.
source_candidates.our_inference: A cancellation trigger must come from an explicit lifetime producer contract; ownership remains with the physical writer through settlement even after its launcher disappears. This is our public-source hypothesis, not a claim about a person's private research plans.
source_candidates.next_falsifiable_gate: Independently launch explicit-bound, no-respawn/background caller and detached-update controls; kill only the launcher, stall the main thread/rollback in separate cases, verify nonce+creation-identity process tree, continued lock renewal until actual owner exit, rollback/lease/service receipts and no early successor, then same-state restart. Record escalation and never label timeout or lost launcher as owner death.
